outline: This course introduces common mathematical methods for engineering applications and helps students know how to solve engineering problems by using mathematical methods. The course includes (1) First-order ordinary differential equation; (2) Higher-order ordinary differential equation; (3) System of ordinary differential equations; (4) Power series method; (5) Laplace transforms and helps students to gain knowledge of engineering mathematics through theories and calculations.
schedule:
Week 1 First order ODEs
Week 2 First order ODEs: Exact and non-Exact ODEs
Week 3 First order ODEs: Linear ODEs
Week 4 Second order linear ODEs
Week 5 Second order linear ODEs
Week 6 Higher order linear ODEs
Week 7 Higher order linear ODEs
Week 8 Midterm exam
Week 9 Systems of ODEs
Week 10 Systems of ODEs
Week 11 Laplace transforms
Week 12 (11/25 Conference break)
Week 13 Laplace transforms
Week 14 Laplace transforms
Week 15 Power series method
Week 16 Final exam
Week 17-18 Practice of solving ODE problems by AI

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
AI 輔助學習與工具應用(AI-assisted learning and tool application)
flexible_learning.content: During Weeks 17-18, students will practice using AI tools to analyze ordinary differential equation problems. If students encounter any issues while using these tools, they are encouraged to consult the instructor.
